candidate: Apply solver-facts.patch to Boundary; World native production unchanged.

direct.intervention: Insert directly into a canonical run/word/tree path rather than interning a singleton and invoking general union.
direct.target: At least 15% lower full native install64 median in two rotating windows, with no higher peak allocation or repeatable tiny/value regression beyond paired noise.
direct.preserved: Exact canonical roots, insertion-order identity, immutable overlays, u64 bounds, allocation-failure preservation, constant incremental prefix descriptions. Existing union/intersection/difference remain independent cross-checks.
direct.reason: Current profile is dominated by set interning; singleton construction is redundant for run extension and word updates.

positions.intervention: Keep the last per-position transfer result as each block is processed by its existing worklist. Final flow validation retains its original order and checks reads/overwrites, reusing the already-derived post-instruction state. Liveness records every processing visit, even when its entry root does not change.
positions.target: at least 15% lower install64 full-path median in two rotating windows for a retained combination; no repeated allocation/latency regression outside matched noise on guards
positions.laws: same fixed point, same facts at every reachable position, same uninitialized/use-after-move/overwrite errors and checking order, same unreachable treatment, complete allocation-failure cleanup
positions.falsifier: a successor changes internal liveness while the predecessor entry root remains unchanged; a loop revises incoming availability before final validation
positions.ownership: All recorded roots are private to the same analysis of immutable input. No caller-provided summaries or proof flags.

probe.base: Boundary d8edcf1; also measure combined with isolated solver-position candidate
probe.intervention: Compute the incoming canonical-node hash once and use one get-or-insert probe when both containers have capacity. Preserve allocation-free existing-key lookup at capacity. Reserve all storage and compute root identity before publishing a new table key.
probe.target: at least 15% full install64 gain for single probe, or at least 25% for the combined candidate, across two rotating windows; no higher peak allocation or guard regression
probe.laws: no uninitialized key escapes or survives failure; cached and recomputed hashes agree; growth preserves roots; immutable overlays unchanged; existing keys succeed under exhausted allocator

key.intervention: Hash only run endpoints, word base+bits, or tree child IDs, with a kind-specific seed. Keep full node equality unchanged, including derived bounds and cardinality.
key.target: at least 15% full install64 improvement alone, or 25% for the solver/single-probe combination; no allocation growth or guard regression
key.safety: Equal nodes still hash identically; collisions are resolved by unchanged exact equality. No admission check, canonicalization rule, root identity or persistent layout changes.
key.comparison: Isolate key choice on the published implementation and measure its interaction with the other candidates.

inline.intervention: Inline the immutable node accessor so callers can load only the fields they use, keeping its assertions and exact lookup behavior.
inline.reason: The current CPU sample assigns 256/3715 leaf samples to Pool.node. It returns a full 40-byte record through an out-of-line boundary.
inline.target: Measure accessor-only and combined effects. The combined 25% full install64 target and original correctness/resource guards remain unchanged.
inline.tradeoff: Record any kernel-size change; this does not remove validation.

combination.change: Add the previously isolated direct insertion operation; its stand-alone gain missed the original target. Re-evaluate only under the changed solver/interner realization.
combination.target: The unchanged combined target is >=25% lower full install64 median in two rotating windows, with resource and value guards.
combination.proof: Union/intersection/difference remain unchanged cross-checks; allocation-free hits, canonical roots and fixed-point validation order remain required.

differential.scope: 1024 generated four-block/six-slot CFGs; compare error identity or every semantic set at entries/instruction positions and liveness positions. This is finite differential evidence, not a universal proof.

adjudication: Individual candidates missed their provisional targets and remain recorded. The final combination meets the unchanged 25% paired install64 target; control64 still trails optimized BPC1. Value-guard ranges show no repeatable slowdown and tracked allocations do not grow.
